items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I can’t deny the fact that I was effected by Jimi Hendrix

ctx.x: Do you think it ever gets to the point where, does it get harder to have your own voice because there’s so many more people that have come before you?

I think that as time goes on we have to realize that nobody can be, like nobody can be me better than me. And I have to tap into all my different influences and I am my own person. And the way I look at things and the way that I am establishes and helps to shape what I’m about. I have a multitude of influences. I mean who said that great line, it’s like to steal from one person is plagiarism, to steal from many is research. And that’s kind of what I’ve done. I mean I’m a product of my time. I didn’t grow up…
Who are some of the musicians you might have stolen from early on?
